notes: Complete list: 72 actions (src/actions.ts: 68 in the main object literal plus refresh_overlay_list, next_story, previous_story, select_story, select_story_by_index, trigger_current_overlay, take_overlay, take_out_overlay, take_out_last_overlay assigned afterwards) and 12 boolean feedbacks (src/feedbacks.ts). Count check: 72 callbacks in actions.ts. All entries are registered unconditionally, including the overlay list actions (they only log a warning when "Enable Overlay List" is off).

The module talks HTTP(S) to the Mosart server: Web API (default, "Use Web API" checked) at http(s)://<host>:<port>/mosart/api/<version> or, with Web API unchecked, the REST API at http(s)://<host>:<port>/api/<version>; default port 55142 (the REST HTTPS default port is stated as 55168 in the config label); optional API key and poll interval (src/config.ts, src/api.ts). Several feedbacks need optional polling switches in the config (timeline info, audio toggles, fader levels, on-air graphics).

Action options are static: no option list is built at runtime. The options of the actions come from literals plus three resolved helpers: deviceTypeChoices(deviceTypes) (ids are the device type strings, labels are the capitalised words), TEMPLATE_TYPES from src/presetGroups.ts for the template action and busChoices/standbyOption constants. The extractor resolved these constants statically.

Several defaults are unusual and recorded as written: template "bus" is a dropdown with the choices Program and Preview but default "" (empty); the "Standby" dropdown uses the strings "true"/"false" as ids.

update_nrcs_settings, update_media_server and upsert_named_overlay take JSON text inputs that are parsed with JSON.parse (parseJsonOption) and must be an object; the description of the action states they apply immediately with no confirmation.

FaderLevel feedback: the "Fader" dropdown lists the channel names known from fader polling at registration time (getKnownFaderChannels) and has allowCustom; no closed list and no default can be recorded (the source default is the first known fader or an empty string). The isVisible function of GraphicOnAir.value is recorded as visibleWhen.

Variables, presets and the preset group configuration (src/presets.ts, src/presetGroups.ts, src/statePresets.ts) are not catalogued. Built on @companion-module/base ^1.14.1: options do not support expressions.
